thread:
maria: Quick check — can we land PR #38211 before tonight's deploy freeze? Linux CI is green, mac-e2e failing intermittently. Rebase window opens at 22:00 UTC; next window is ~48h. Need final approvals and an eye on mac flakes.

alex: I can review in ~30m. Quick skim looks fine from my side. main concern is the migration ordering with PR #37900.

jen: I'm remote until 19:00 UTC but can drop a quick approve if mac passes. Which mac test is failing?

ci-bot: [mac-e2e] Failed: integration/test_clipboard.py::TestClipboard::test_copy_paste — Exit 137 on runner-mac-12

maria: thanks @jen. The failing trace is here: https://ci.redwood/12345/build/67890 — also see attached logs. Repro locally on macos-12 with Docker. Short workaround is to set env CI_SKIP_CLIP=1 but that's not ideal.

sam-oncall: If we can't get mac green by 20:30 UTC I'd rather hold the merge. We have a db-migration in the pipeline; don't want a rollback during freeze. :warning:

alex: Agreed. Alternative: create a hotfix branch with the small change (non-migration parts) and land that before freeze. That keeps mainline clean.

maria: proposal — run one more mac rerun immediately; if it passes and both @alex and @jen approve by 20:15 UTC we merge before freeze. Otherwise we'll defer to next rebase window. I can open a hotfix branch if needed.

jen: I'm +1 on that plan. If rerun fails, open the hotfix and ping me — I'll review ASAP.

alex: LGTM. If you open hotfix, tag me for merge afterwards. :+1:

ci-bot: Rerun queued (build 67891). ETA ~18m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/12345/build/67891

maria: Kicking the rerun now. pinging reviewers in case they miss this thread.

jen: saw the ping, will aim to review as soon as rerun finishes.

maria: Update — rerun is green on mac. Results: linux+mac all green. @alex @jen please ack so I can merge before 22:00 UTC.

alex: ack — approved. small conflict resolved in rebase.

jen: approved. One minor doc comment but not blocking. Merge when ready. :shipit:

maria: Merged at 21:22 UTC. Noting in release notes and closing the hold. Thanks everyone. :tada:
